title: A central job record holds no executor path: a credential refusal names the credential, not its directory, and the log path stays on the host
goal: the reason an executor posts to the central record for a missing credential names the identity and the variable or file name, never CRED_DIR or a home directory, and note_log posts the log's job-relative name, with the host named by kbjob.py log as today, so coord holds states and events only
